fullPassage: Energy can always be injected into an organization to motivate people to do things. Bonuses, promotions, other carrots, and even a few sticks can get people to work harder, for sure, but the gains are, like all manipulations, short-term. Over time, such tactics cost more money and increase stress for employee and employer alike, and eventually will become the main reason people show up for work every day. That’s not loyalty. That’s the employee version of repeat business. Loyalty among employees is when they turn down more money or benefits to continue working at the same company. Loyalty to a company trumps pay and benefits. And unless you’re an astronaut, it’s not the work we do that inspires us either. It’s the cause that we come to work for. We don’t want to come to work to build a wall; we want to come to work to build a cathedral.

questions.passage: Energy can always be injected into an organization to motivate people to do things. Bonuses, promotions, other carrots, and even a few sticks can get people to work harder, for sure, but the gains are, like all manipulations, short-term. Over time, such tactics cost more money and increase stress for employee and employer alike, and eventually will become the main reason people show up for work every day. That’s not loyalty. That’s the employee version of repeat business. Loyalty among employees is when they turn down more money or benefits to continue working at the same company. Loyalty to a company trumps pay and benefits. And unless you’re an astronaut, it’s not the work we do that inspires us either. It’s the cause that we come to work for. We don’t want to come to work to build a wall; we want to come to work to build a cathedral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 외적 보상(조작) vs 진정한 충성(대의)
det.analysis:
① 장기적 효과 — 본문은 단기적이라 함 ❌
② 외적 보상 vs 충성심 — 조작(단기)과 충성(대의) 대비 ✅ ←정답
③ 스트레스 관리 — 주제 아님 ❌
④ 우주비행사 — 예시일 뿐 ❌

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 보상이 아닌 대의 → 진정한 충성
det.analysis:
① 높은 급여 → 충성 — 본문 반대(충성은 급여를 능가) ❌
② 반복적 보상 — 조작은 단기적 ❌
③ 스트레스 감소 — 주된 요지가 아님 ❌
④ 보상 아닌 대의 — 벽이 아닌 성당 비유와 일치 ✅ ←정답
det.tip: build a cathedral ≠ build a wall

ch: 직원에게 더 높은 급여를 지급해야 충성을 얻는다.
반복적인 보상 체계가 조직 성과의 핵심이다.
스트레스 감소가 직원 이직 방지의 최우선 과제이다.
사람들은 보상이 아닌 의미 있는 대의를 위해 일할 때 진정한 충성심을 갖는다.
